role: COPY #3 of NFTStaker. Replaces APY-target model with owner-set DEPLETION-WINDOW model (rate = budget/windowSeconds, totalStaked-INDEPENDENT). Adds a stable-staker-style migration lifecycle (PoolState Active/Migrating) and rescueERC20. Wired to Uniboost dispatcher (IUniboostMintDebtHook).

verifiedProperties.noUnboundedLoops: batchMigrate loops accounts[] but onlyMigrator (owner/orchestrator) and batched off-chain

intendedDeltasVsBase: targetAPY/MAX_TARGET_APY/APY_PRECISION REMOVED; replaced by depletionWindowMonths, SECONDS_PER_MONTH (365d/12), MAX_DEPLETION_MONTHS (120)

_recomputeSchedule rewritten: rate=budget/windowSeconds, windowEnd=now+windowSeconds, lastRewardTime=now; DROPS latestPrice/S/F price math; also SETS lastRewardTime (base does not set it in recompute)
_syncBudget DIVERGES: recomputes ONLY on inflow>0; no-hook branch just returns (base ALWAYS recomputes)
stake/unstake have NO tail _recomputeSchedule (rate is totalStaked-independent; base has tail recompute)
NEW: PoolState/migrator/migration primitives; rescueERC20 (rewardToken-guarded); Rescued event

localFindings.description: Every hook inflow>0 RESTARTS the full depletion window (windowEnd = now + windowSeconds) AND resets rate = budget/window. A single late mint resets the drain clock for existing stakers, lowering their per-second rate. Distinct from base (windowEnd naturally shrinks). Design-intended per NatSpec ('new NFT minted -> budget grew -> restart window (intended)') but the fairness/rate-dilution effect is cross-interaction: DEFER to econ-scanner.
localFindings.recommendation: econ-scanner: confirm window-restart-on-inflow cannot be griefed by dust mints to dilute existing stakers' emission rate.

externalEntryPoints.notes: same accrual machinery as base BUT no tail recompute; _syncBudget recomputes only on inflow.
require Active; _syncBudget (settle+sweep) then flip to Migrating; freezes emissions (_updatePool no-ops while Migrating).
require Migrating; per-user _exitPosition (settle frozen pending via _safePayTo, zero position), aggregate ERC1155 safeTransferFrom(this->migrator). Idempotent. Callable while paused.

externalEntryPoints.access: permissionless, require Migrating & own amount>0, nonReentrant
externalEntryPoints.notes: self-exit; CEI; returns own stake + settles pending.

revive same staker to Active; fast-forwards lastRewardTime (no retro-accrual of frozen gap).
if token==rewardToken: _updatePool, transfer, require(balance>=committedDebt), _recomputeSchedule (invariant-safe surplus recovery). Else free transfer. Callable while paused.
months in [1,120]; settles at OLD rate first.
